text:
lily.marketing: Quick sync — we need a small SDR handbook update + two battlecard variants for the inbound routing experiment. Goal: sharper one-liners vs cloud AI platforms and a short benchmark callout for the webinar.
marco.growth: +1. Can we prioritize hooks that tie to latency/cost and reliable fallbacks? those are our strongest spots. :thinking_face: 
priya.sales: SDRs need 2x soundbites: one for technical champions (latency/throughput) and one for procurement (cost predictability/commits). Keep each <= 2 lines.
jordan.product: For benchmarks, use the QPS60 conversational baseline we ran last month. Callout: "consistent p95 < 350ms with reserved capacity" — validated on dedicated.
sam.benchmarks: I can craft a one-sentence stat and a tiny chart snippet. Proposed stat: "Redwood Dedicated: median token latency 42ms, p95 320ms, 35% lower per-token cost vs default cloud-managed endpoints on sample webchat workload." Want source file?
lily.marketing: Yes please include source link. Also we need two battlecard frames: "Econ-first" (cost + batching + quantization) and "Reliability-first" (SLA, fallbacks, routing).
marco.growth: For messaging testing, let's A/B those two across inbound routing segments: low-touch trial signups -> Econ-first, enterprise >10k tokens/mo -> Reliability-first.
alex.sdr_lead: Can we get 4-6 bullets each? SDRs prefer bulleted rebut lines. Keep them short.
priya.sales: Suggested Econ-first bullets: 1) "Lower unit token cost via smart batching + adaptive quantization." 2) "Prescriptive config recommendations for your workload." 3) "Predictable billing with reserved pools."
jordan.product: Suggested Reliability-first bullets: 1) "SLA-backed Dedicated pools and canary rollouts." 2) "Automatic model fallback across capacity tiers." 3) "KV prefix caching to keep tail latency tight."
sam.benchmarks: I'll draft the stat lines + a tiny methods note: dataset = 'web_inbound-100'; model variants = open-llm-7b, redwood-opt-7b; infra = gpus x2. Will attach raw numbers.
marco.growth: For SDR handset, add quick objection answers: Q: "How are you cheaper?" A: "Unit economics + autoscaling + prefix cache reduces tokens served." Q: "How do you avoid downtime?" A: "Smart routing + regional fallbacks + SLA for Dedicated."
lily.marketing: Nice. Can someone draft final copy for the handbook and the short copy for the webinar slide (one stat + one line)? Timeline: want a first pass by Thursday EOD.
priya.sales: I'll draft SDR bullets and objection QAs by Wednesday morning and route for review.
sam.benchmarks: I'll export the bench screenshot and a 1-line methods blurb by Wednesday evening.
jordan.product: I'll validate the p95 phrasing with infra team and confirm numbers by Thursday noon.
marco.growth: I'll set up the A/B routing flags in our inbound stack: rules: 
```
route.set("inbound.segment", {
  "small_trial": "econ-first",
  "enterprise": "reliability-first",
  "unknown": "econ-first"
})
```
Will run sampling for 1 week.
alex.sdr_lead: If routing is live we want a short playbook: which segment to push to AE, which to nurture. Will write that once copy is final.
lily.marketing: One more ask — keep competitive lines non-attacking: no vendor names in bullets, but okay to say "managed endpoints" or "cloud-managed offerings".
marco.growth: noted. Also let's prep 3 quick rebut soundbites for the webinar Q&A: 1) economics, 2) reliability, 3) rollout/tooling.
priya.sales: Got it. I'll produce the SDR handbook draft and 6 bullets per frame.
lily.marketing: Great — owner assignments: SDR copy @priya.sales, benchmarks @sam.benchmarks, routing flags @marco.growth, infra validation @jordan.product, playbook @alex.sdr_lead. Check-in Friday 9am for final grooming.
marco.growth: I'll drop a short Trello card + tag assignees. :white_check_mark: 
priya.sales: Thanks — will ping if questions.
lily.marketing: Thanks team, moving to action. :rocket:
